I can't tell you what to do with your money, but I can share some perspective to help you decide.

**Investing your bonus can be a good choice if:**
- You have an emergency fund (3–6 months of expenses)
- You're not carrying high-interest debt
- You have a time horizon (5+ years for most investments)
- You can afford to leave the money untouched

**Consider keeping it (or a portion) if:**
- You have outstanding high-interest debt (credit cards, etc.)
- Your emergency fund is thin
- You have upcoming major expenses (home, car, etc.)
- You don't have a clear investment plan

**A balanced approach many people use:**
- Split it — some to savings/debt, some to investing
- Or invest a portion you're comfortable potentially losing

If you do invest, low-cost index funds are a common starting point, but what makes sense depends on your full financial picture. Would you like help thinking through any of this?
